pageProps.title: Finnmark Mushroom Postcard
pageProps.review: Location of the Finnmark Mushroom Postcard. The address is Behrens plass Kaisvingen 8, Kirkenes, Finnmark. If it doesn't appear alone, turn on the detector and move around nearby to find it.
pageProps.content: ```adcard ``` October 2026, around autumn, here is the Finnmark Mushroom Postcard. The mural was unexpectedly adorable, so I sent an expedition and received a postcard. If I get a chance next time, I'll look for other pretty spots nearby as well. ```adcard ```
